svg.title: Object Model — Orientation Relationships And Variants
svg.desc: UML-style object model of pytex.core.transformation: the orientation relationship, its parallelism constraints, the variant set it generates, and the report objects that carry a characterization result together with its provenance.
svg.text: Object Model — Orientation Relationships And Variants
The flagship transformation-crystallography model: relationships, variants, and the records that make a result explainable
composition - a required field: the owner cannot exist without it
association - an optional or defaulted field
* after a field name: the field holds a sequence
ProvenanceRecord is omitted: 103 classes carry it, on every result object.
Fields naming another card are listed first; the rest are summarized.
